facts.text: I am looking for advice on creating a routine to help me stay consistent with my sleep schedule.
I go to bed around 11:30 pm.
I am stuck on the train for 30 minutes during my morning commute.
I take a power nap during the day around 2:30 pm.
I want podcast recommendations for my morning commute to help me stay engaged and awake.
I want podcast recommendations that are around 15-20 minutes long for some days with a shorter commute.
I want the best way to prioritize getting enough sleep while also fitting in time for exercise and other activities I enjoy.
